$comment: Device-storage inventory (add-privacy-and-compliance, spec legal-pages 'Device-storage inventory'; add-theme-switch D5). Single source for the tables on /cookies. 'routes' lists what each page stores on its own: nothing. 'preferences' lists what is stored only when the visitor chooses it: the theme. Enforced by verify-build (no storage API in any shipped bundle unless listed under 'apis', and a listed API only in the asset named by 'apiFiles') and by e2e/specs/08-legal.spec.ts (per-route sweep, before and after choosing a theme). Audit 2026-10-08: the only storage access in the shipped build is localStorage in src/theme/theme-init.js (assets/theme-<hash>.js); no document.cookie, sessionStorage, indexedDB, caches, serviceWorker, cookieStore or navigator.storage.

preferences.where: Every page (one key for the whole site)
preferences.purpose: Remembers the theme you picked in the Theme menu, so every page opens in it.
preferences.saved: Only when you choose Light or Dark. Choosing System deletes it.
preferences.lifetime: Until you choose System or clear this site's data in your browser. It holds no identifier and is never sent anywhere.

thirdParty.note: Cloudflare states the beacon uses no cookies or localStorage. It runs only on the landing page, only when enabled, and never when GPC or Do Not Track is on.
